messages:
Erin (product): quick quarterly pulse — can each owner drop a 1-line: shipped / slipped / next step for your milestone this sprint? keeping it super short. please @mention any deps. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Maya (pm): shipped: feature-flag rollout for routing policy to canary (50%). slipped: docs and runbook not finished. next step: @Sam to add runbook snippets by EOD Thu.

Sam (eng): shipped: batching perf patch merged (0.8x token cost down in tests). slipped: CI flaked on windows infra tests, debugging. next step: repro + fix failing test, @Tess FYI for flakey infra.

Tess (sre): noted flake. can repro in staging; looks like docker image race during startup. next step: locking image pull order in startup script. estimate fix in tomorrow's deploy.

Oliver (eng-ml): shipped: quantized v2 model config validated on dedicated pool (latency within SLO). slipped: eval job for long prompts still shows quality regression for a small prompt set. next step: running targeted eval with pruning of quantization blocks, pinging @Sam for kernel config change.

Maya (pm): deps: need docs from Erin for enterprise rollout notes, and a final accept from security. tagging @Erin (product) and @Tess.

Erin (product): ack — I'll drop a short enterprise-notes draft by noon. security review scheduled Fri, otherwise we may delay Dedicated GA by one week.

Sam (eng): quick CR ping: PR #4821 needs another review for the batching change (small API surface). can someone take a look? cc @Oliver.

Oliver (eng-ml): taking a look now, should be a quick approve unless CI hiccups.

deploy-bot: deployment queued: routing-canary v3 -> canary-50% starting at 2026-03-17T18:30Z. Monitor: /deploys/routing-canary/v3

Tess (sre): for visibility: I'll watch the canary rollout and post any infra alerts here. if the docker race fix isn't in by deploy, I'll rollback automatically. :thumbsup:

Maya (pm): final quick note — owners aligned on priorities. if anything slips beyond next week, please update this thread with ETA and risk so we can re-prioritize. thanks all :)

Erin (product): thanks — summary for roadmap doc: shipped: routing canary, batching perf, quantized config validated. slipped: docs/runbook, windows CI test, eval regressions. owners: @Maya (pm) runbooks + docs, @Sam (eng) CI test fix, @Oliver (eng-ml) eval, @Tess (sre) infra fix. next sync: async update by EOD Thu.
